suites.title: Web accessibility, loading, and resilience states
suites.description: The web app should remain usable with keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, loading states, and retryable errors.

cases.title: Navigate primary controls with the keyboard
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
When the tester tabs through the header, profile menu, task dialog, and settings sheet
Then focus should move through interactive controls in a logical order
And Escape should close open dialogs or sheets without saving unintended changes

cases.title: Save a task with the dialog keyboard shortcut
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the new task dialog is open
And the tester has entered valid task content
When the tester presses the dialog save shortcut
Then the task should be saved once
And the dialog should close without leaving duplicate entries

cases.title: Preserve layout on a narrow browser viewport
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester opens the dashboard on a mobile-width browser viewport
When the quick view, profile sheet, task dialog, and settings sheet are opened
Then controls and text should remain visible without overlapping
And the tester should be able to create, edit, and close a task

cases.title: Keep the dashboard shell stable while tasks load
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester opens the protected dashboard with a slow task fetch
When the app is loading tasks
Then the header and loading or empty state should remain coherent
And the app should not redirect away from the protected workspace for an authenticated user

cases.title: Recover from a failed task save attempt
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in and the task dialog is open
When a task create or update request fails
Then the app should leave the tester in a recoverable state
And a subsequent successful save should refresh the board without duplicate tasks

suites.title: Web advanced mode and filters
suites.description: Advanced controls should help a tester search, filter, and organize work without losing state.

cases.title: Enable advanced mode from the profile menu
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains a mix of labels, priorities, and completed tasks

steps.action: When the tester opens the profile menu
And the tester enables Advanced Mode
Then extra filtering controls should appear in quick view
And the choice should persist after a page refresh

cases.title: Search and filter quick view tasks
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains a mix of labels, priorities, and completed tasks

steps.action: Given advanced mode is enabled
When the tester searches for a known task keyword
And the tester filters by one or more category labels
Then only matching tasks should remain visible in the task columns

cases.title: Sort tasks by priority and clear filters
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains a mix of labels, priorities, and completed tasks

steps.action: Given advanced mode is enabled
When the tester toggles the priority sort control
Then tasks in the active view should reorder by priority
When the tester clears the active filters
Then the default unfiltered board should return

cases.title: Use profile menu preferences that affect board visibility
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains a mix of labels, priorities, and completed tasks

steps.action: When the tester opens the profile menu
And the tester toggles Hide Completed Tasks or Auto-move due tasks
Then the board should update to reflect the new preference
And the preference should still be applied after a reload

cases.title: Auto-move due Tomorrow tasks into Today
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains a mix of labels, priorities, and completed tasks

steps.action: Given Auto-move due tasks is enabled
And the tester has an open Tomorrow task whose scheduled date is today or earlier
When the dashboard refreshes task data
Then the task should move into Today
And it should keep its content, priority, and category label

suites.title: Web authentication validation and route guards
suites.description: Authentication forms should block incomplete input, explain auth failures, and route users to the correct surface.

cases.title: Block sign in with missing fields
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login page
When the tester submits the sign in form without an email address
Then the app should ask for the email used with Offtasks
When the tester enters an email address without a password
Then the app should ask for a password before continuing

cases.title: Show a mapped auth error for invalid credentials
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login page
When the tester enters an existing email address with an invalid password
And the tester submits the sign in form
Then the app should show a friendly authentication error
And the tester should remain on the login page with the form usable

cases.title: Enforce signup password and confirmation rules
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the signup page
When the tester submits incomplete signup fields
Then the app should ask the tester to fill in all fields
When the tester enters a weak password or mismatched confirmation
Then the password checklist or mismatch error should explain what to fix

cases.title: Reject password reset without an account email
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the forgot password page
When the tester submits the form without an email address
Then the app should ask for the email tied to the Offtasks account
And no reset email confirmation should appear

cases.title: Handle invalid or expired reset links
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the reset password page without a valid recovery token
When the tester attempts to save a new password
Then the app should explain that the reset link is invalid or expired
And the tester should be able to return to login and request a new link

cases.title: Apply guest and protected route guards
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester is signed out
When the tester opens the protected /app route directly
Then the app should redirect to the login page
Given the tester is signed in
When the tester opens login, signup, or forgot password directly
Then the app should redirect to the protected dashboard

suites.title: Web authentication
suites.description: The web app should let a user sign in, register, and recover access without leaving the browser flow.

cases.title: Sign in with a confirmed account
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login page
When the tester enters a confirmed email address and valid password
And the tester submits the sign in form
Then the app should show the welcome back confirmation state
And the tester should be redirected to the dashboard

cases.title: Create a new account from the signup screen
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester is on the login page
When the tester opens the create account flow
And the tester enters a new email address and matching passwords
And the tester submits the signup form
Then the app should confirm that an account was created
And the tester should be able to open the dashboard without confirming email first

cases.title: Request a password reset email from login
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester is on the login page
When the tester enters an existing account email address
And the tester triggers the forgot password action
Then the app should confirm that a reset link was sent
And no unexpected validation or transport error should appear

cases.title: Complete the password reset screen from the email link
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester has opened the reset password page from a valid reset link
When the tester enters matching replacement passwords
And the tester saves the new password
Then the app should confirm that the password was updated
And the tester should be redirected back to the login screen

cases.title: Delete a disposable account from the profile menu
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in with a disposable account that has at least one synced task
When the tester opens the profile menu and chooses Delete Account
And the tester confirms the delete account dialog
Then the app should redirect to the login page
And signing in again with the deleted account should fail
And the Supabase project should no longer contain that user's auth row, tasks, or preferences

suites.title: Web history and profile controls
suites.description: The profile menu and history sheet should expose account controls and completed-task context.

cases.title: Inspect profile menu account controls
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: When the tester opens the profile menu
Then the menu should show the user summary and completion count
And the menu should expose actions for search, statistics, theme, and logout

cases.title: Toggle the web theme from the profile menu
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: Given the profile menu is open
When the tester switches the theme mode
Then the app shell should update between light and dark appearance
And the chosen theme should remain applied after refresh

cases.title: Review completed task history by relative date
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: When the tester opens the task history sheet
Then completed tasks should be grouped under relative date headings such as Today or Yesterday
And each history item should still show its original board label such as Today, Tomorrow, or Later

cases.title: Sign out from the profile menu
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: Given the profile menu is open
When the tester logs out
Then the current session should end
And the app should return to the login route

cases.title: Review web settings sheet account and data controls
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: When the tester opens the profile menu
And the tester opens Settings
Then the settings sheet should show the account email and Supabase sync status
And the settings sheet should expose search, appearance, keyboard shortcut, about, and data sections

cases.title: Search all tasks from the settings sheet
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: Given the settings sheet is open
When the tester searches for a known task keyword
Then matching open and completed tasks should appear in the settings results area
And the tester should be able to complete or reopen a result from the sheet

suites.title: Web public site and legal routes
suites.description: The public web experience should introduce Offtasks, link visitors into auth, and support legal or support requests.

cases.title: Review the public landing page calls to action
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the public home page
When the landing page finishes rendering
Then the page should show the Offtasks value proposition and feature list
And the primary action should lead a signed-out visitor to signup
And the sign in action should lead to login

cases.title: Open the workspace from the landing page when already signed in
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester has an authenticated web session
When the tester opens the public home page
Then the primary action should offer to open the workspace
When the tester follows that action
Then the protected dashboard should load without an extra login step

cases.title: Navigate privacy, terms, support, and contact routes
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the public home page
When the tester follows the footer or direct links for Privacy, Terms, Support, and Contact
Then each legal or support page should render the expected title and updated date
And each page should provide a path back to the home page

cases.title: Validate the support contact form
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the support contact form
When the tester submits the form with a missing name, email, or message
Then the form should show a validation error
And no success state should be shown

cases.title: Submit a support contact message
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the support contact form
When the tester enters a name, email, and support message
And the tester submits the form
Then the form should show the sending state while the request is in flight
And the form should either show Message sent or a retryable submit error

cases.title: Redirect unknown public routes to the landing page
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens an unknown public route
When the app router handles the route
Then the tester should land on the public home page
And the browser should not show the protected dashboard unless the route is /app

suites.title: Web quick view dashboard
suites.description: The quick view should keep the active task board readable across Today, Tomorrow, and Later.

cases.title: Load the protected dashboard workspace
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard is open on the quick view tab

steps.action: When the page finishes loading
Then the header should render without redirecting back to login
And the quick view should show task columns for Today, Tomorrow, and Later

cases.title: Review task placement across the board
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard is open on the quick view tab

steps.action: Given there are tasks scheduled for Today, Tomorrow, and Later
When the tester reviews the board columns
Then each task should appear in the correct column for its target group
And completed items should follow the current completed visibility setting

cases.title: Open a task for editing from the board
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard is open on the quick view tab

steps.action: Given at least one task is visible in quick view
When the tester opens the edit action for that task
Then the task dialog should open with the current task values prefilled
And the tester should be able to cancel without mutating the task

cases.title: Use the keyboard shortcut for fast task entry
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard is open on the quick view tab

steps.action: Given the tester is focused outside any input field
When the tester presses the quick add shortcut for a new task
Then the task dialog should open in create mode
And the default target group should be Today

cases.title: Show the first-task empty state for a new account
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard is open on the quick view tab

steps.action: Given the signed-in account has no tasks
When the dashboard finishes loading
Then the app should show the no-tasks empty state
And the empty-state action should open a new Today task dialog

suites.title: Web scheduling and category lifecycle
suites.description: Task dates, board placement, priority, and category labels should stay consistent across create and edit flows.

cases.title: Schedule tasks into Today, Tomorrow, Later, and backlog
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: When the tester creates tasks with Today, Tomorrow, a future Later date, and no scheduled date
Then each task should appear in the expected board column
And the no-date task should remain in Later as backlog work

cases.title: Normalize a past scheduled date to Today
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: When the tester creates or edits a task with a date before today
And the tester saves the task
Then the task should be corrected into Today
And the saved task should not keep an impossible past target group

cases.title: Create and reuse a custom category from the task dialog
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: When the tester opens the category selector in the task dialog
And the tester searches for a category that does not exist
And the tester adds that category to a task
Then the category should be visible on the saved task
When the tester opens another task dialog
Then the custom category should be available for reuse

cases.title: Clear optional category and priority values while editing
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given a task has a category label and non-default priority
When the tester edits the task and clears the category and priority
And the tester saves the change
Then the board should show the task without the old label or priority marker

cases.title: Preserve category list after reload
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given the tester has added a custom category through the task dialog
When the tester reloads the dashboard
Then the custom category should remain available in the category selector
And tasks using that category should keep their label styling

cases.title: Keep priority ordering stable for equal priorities
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains tasks that can be safely edited or removed

steps.action: Given advanced mode is enabled
And the current view contains multiple tasks with the same priority
When the tester toggles priority sorting
Then tasks should group by priority without losing any tasks
And tasks with equal priority should remain readable and selectable

suites.title: Web settings, persistence, and cross-platform sync
suites.description: Web preferences and task data should persist locally, sync through Supabase, and reflect changes made by mobile.

cases.title: Review settings sheet account, about, and data sections
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: When the tester opens the profile menu
And the tester opens Settings
Then the settings sheet should show the account email and Supabase sync status
And the sheet should show appearance, keyboard shortcut, about, and data information

cases.title: Search and update tasks from settings
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the settings sheet is open
When the tester searches for a known task keyword
Then matching tasks should appear in the settings search results
When the tester completes or reopens a matching result
Then the same state should be reflected on the dashboard after the sheet closes

cases.title: Persist web preferences across reload and sign-in cycles
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: When the tester changes theme, Advanced Mode, Hide Completed Tasks, and Auto-move due tasks
And the tester reloads the page
Then each preference should still be applied
When the tester signs out and signs back in with the same account
Then synced preferences should be restored from Supabase

cases.title: Reflect a mobile-created task on the web dashboard
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the tester creates a uniquely named task in the mobile app with the same account
When the tester refreshes the web dashboard
Then the mobile-created task should appear in the matching Today, Tomorrow, or Later column
And its priority, date, completion state, and category should match mobile

cases.title: Reflect a web edit in the mobile app
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given a shared task is visible on web and mobile
When the tester edits the task content, date, priority, category, or completion state on web
And the tester refreshes the mobile app
Then mobile should show the web edit without creating a duplicate task

suites.title: Web statistics workspace
suites.description: The statistics tab should summarize wins, open issues, and task health in one place.

cases.title: Open the statistics tab from the dashboard shell
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open, overdue, and completed tasks

steps.action: When the tester opens the statistics view from the header or profile menu
Then the statistics workspace should replace the quick view content
And the page should show summary cards for closed issues, open issues, and wins today

cases.title: Review recent wins and open issue spotlight content
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open, overdue, and completed tasks

steps.action: Given the statistics view is open
When the tester scrolls through the analytics sections
Then recent completed tasks should appear in the wins area
And high priority or overdue open tasks should appear in the open issues sections

cases.title: Jump from statistics into task search
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open, overdue, and completed tasks

steps.action: Given the statistics view is open
When the tester uses the search action inside statistics
Then the app should return to a quick view context that supports task search
And the tester should be able to locate a task without leaving the dashboard

cases.title: Open the compact stats sheet from the profile menu
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open, overdue, and completed tasks

steps.action: When the tester opens the profile menu
And the tester opens the stats summary sheet
Then the sheet should show completion totals for today, this week, and this month
And category completion counts should match the current task data

suites.title: Web task management
suites.description: The task dialog and board interactions should support the full task lifecycle.

cases.title: Create a task with category and priority
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains at least one editable task

steps.action: When the tester opens the new task dialog
And the tester enters task content
And the tester selects a target group, priority, and optional category label
And the tester saves the task
Then the new task should appear in the expected board column
And the selected label or category should be visible on the saved task

cases.title: Update an existing task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible on the board
When the tester edits the task content, priority, or category label
And the tester saves the changes
Then the updated task should reflect the new values on the board

cases.title: Toggle a task between open and completed
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an open task is visible on the board
When the tester marks the task as completed
Then the task should visually reflect the completed state
When the tester reopens the same task
Then the task should return to the open state without disappearing unexpectedly

cases.title: Delete a task from the board
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible on the board
When the tester deletes the task and confirms the action if prompted
Then the task should no longer appear in the board list after refresh

cases.title: Prevent saving an empty task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains at least one editable task

steps.action: When the tester opens the new task dialog
And the tester leaves the task content blank
Then the save action should remain unavailable
And no empty task should be added to Today, Tomorrow, or Later

cases.title: Persist task edits after a browser reload
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the dashboard contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible on the board
When the tester changes its content, priority, date, or category label
And the tester reloads the dashboard after the save completes
Then the edited values should still be visible on the same task
